description: Plan-review gates on ExitPlanMode. PreToolUse runs plan-unknowns-gate.py, a Codex (OpenAI CLI, read-only sandbox) unknowns audit that blocks until an '## Open Unknowns' section exists (without Codex the deny carries a generic instruction; an error in the gate itself never blocks). A sibling plan-worktree-gate.py advises when implementation warrants a documented '## Git Isolation Strategy', becomes a hard gate under CLAUDE_PLAN_WORKTREE_REQUIRE=1, opts out with CLAUDE_PLAN_WORKTREE_GATE=0, and defers to the unknowns gate until the plan is mature. PostToolUse runs plan-review-cleanup.py to clear the worktree-assessment sentinel after a successful exit. Opt out of the unknowns gate with CLAUDE_PLAN_UNKNOWNS_GATE=0.

hooks.statusMessage: Codex auditing plan for unresolved unknowns...
